Cash is only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. It uses a slightly different method of distributing cash between players, as enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player does all the damage to an enemy, both players will receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you receive 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it is damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it is a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it is at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it is less than 0.5, it gets rounded down. For example, the

Headquarters notified us of Molten enemies in the area. Additionally, there are zombies nearby that could be attracted to the fighting.
The Molten are highly aggressive, so we need to be careful. The last rift they came from ended with an entire outpost being burned down. No one survived.
Commander, from what we know about the Molten, they are a warrior-based society. These guys literally live and breathe war.
Also, their societal ranking is based on strength and victories. If they see us as a challenge, it could be a matter of time until something extremely dangerous comes to fight us.
Where did you get the information about the Molten anyway, V?
You saw a chained creature come out of my lab and you're still surprised?
We've got an Elite Abnormal Boss coming through!
The zombies must be attracted to all the noise we're making. Great. Just what we need.
There's our first Molten sighting! Wait—What's going on with their corpses?
Oh! How interesting! They're using their dead friends to shield themselves! That's…kinda' metal.
While Medic was fooling around examining the guts of these guys, I forgot to mention about the Hidden Molten that have appeared. Whoopsies! You… might want to keep an eye out for them.
Argh! It's hard to see these guys!
They're using heat distortion to blur themselves out!
What did they do to that thing?!
Did they reinforce themselves with melted iron?!
If I asked nicely, could you bring me back a—
I feel like I'm going to be sick! What is that Boomer?!
It looks like they're comprised of flammable nauseous gas. Stay away from it!
Watch out for those dogs! Down boy! Let's send you back to the— uh… cough…
They're starting to send tougher enemies, V! Where are they getting this technology?!
They must have stolen it from the outpost armories! Watch out for that Molten Mech!
Focus our weapons on that Bulwark! We can't let it past us!
Not good, REALLY not good! The Bulwark is one of the Molten's most veteran fighters. If it's here—… Commander. You need to prepare yourselves quickly!
I'm seeing a huge movement of enemies heading in your direction. Too many in one area would be complete scorched earth!
We're working on it! Everyone WILL make it out of here alive!
Those executioners won't hesitate to kill whoever runs away. They see you as a threat. You need to get out of there!
It's too late! If we don't do something now, people will get hurt!
No. Oh no… Commander the heat is becoming so intense — it's ruining my instruments! This could only mean that—
The Warlord is coming for us.
I knew it! This is it!
If we're to survive, we need to give it everything we've got!
